Add tests/metadata.rs::r13_service_versions_require_strings and tests/cli_xam.rs::r13_cli_rejects_nonstrings_in_service_versions using the unchanged literal inc8 object plus the exact appended section above, without support::rehash. No execution input/budget is needed. Current code admits every negative; the type check makes them fail at admission.

{"A_tab":0,"H":6,"S_cells":"18446744073709551615","globals":{},"heap_base":48,"heap_limit_max":0,"interface_regions":{},"null_size":1,"ptr_width":32}
. This pin was independently SHA-256 derived from the unchanged inc8 definition/signature and seven ordered scalar layout lines. Object hash is f581d1d9418da1213057fb7e6cc95c3d35619aa478f9c6fc275502a5371bd44a. check exits 0/status ok. run-oracle <object> inc8 --input 8 --budget 0,0,0,0 returns {"code":1,"payload":0,"steps":0}, as required. reverse with the same arguments exits 101, empty stdout, and panics at src/machine.rs:81:18, "attempt to add with overflow": s fits usize but s+1 does not. The analogous A_tab="18446744073709551615", S_cells=0 object, independently pinned dc2c21a6b7c2a0fea8a6881564f80b44c3742d681e71576ec6f4d66fa058f683 (object cf57de219961a2cc9e02b768a8b59b984b2ba2c5aa40b48c333b1ffcbb405ef0), also checks successfully and panics at machine.rs:85:17 in a+1. sol.fix: Change reference-interpreter/src/machine.rs::DerivedWidths::from_program to checked-add the derived widths (in particular s.checked_add(1), a.checked_add(1)), propagating a descriptive host-resource Error before constructing counters/slots. Audit the adjacent size/width calculations for the same boundary. Determining §3.7 text: "sp, fp : wire[Sc], Sc ≥ S_cells + 1" and "atop : wire[Ac], Ac ≥ A_tab + 1"; §7.2 defines the size exponents without an upper bound on A_tab/S_cells. §5.2 says F_B is (0,FAULT_BUDGET_STEPS) when not halted after B steps, so B=0 remains (0,1). The spec does not prescribe a host-resource error spelling: the implementation's existing explicit host-limit convention is a defensible way to report a width the host cannot represent; a panic/wrapped width or a newly invented ISA exponent cap is not. Add tests/r1_widths.rs::r13_derived_counter_width_overflow_reports_host_limit and tests/cli_xam.rs::r13_cli_counter_width_limit_is_a_diagnostic. On this 64-bit host, use both literal correctly pinned objects above, B=0, heap/stack/depth=0 and input 8. Assert parse/check succeed and sequential run-oracle returns exactly (0,1,0); DerivedWidths::derive and OracleVectorMachine::new must return a host-resource Err without unwinding. CLI reverse must exit 1 with empty stdout and a host-limit diagnostic, never exit 101/panic. A representation that handles these zero-budget counters sparsely may instead successfully reverse to entry; either implementation must preserve the abstract result and never narrow legal layout admission. Retain ordinary S_cells=9 recursive-call reversal as the positive control. Current code panics on both supplied boundary objects.

codex.fix: Change reference-interpreter/src/object.rs::Object::validate_layout to validate block_image whenever present: require a string satisfying the data NAME syntax and an existing defined data image, independent of symbol kinds, closure selection or whether any effect uses block. The determining §9.1 schema is `"block_image"?: "<data name>"`; §7.3 specifies `sector map from the block_image (else empty), 512-byte sectors`; §15 suite F includes `schemas`. Optional absence is legal; present numbers, null, booleans, arrays/objects, empty names and undeclared names are load errors. Keep existing complete-512-byte-sector validation and preferably perform that image-shape validation at the same admission boundary. In src/classical.rs::ClassicalMachine::construct, replace object.data[image.string()?] with a checked get returning a cited §7.3/§9.1 error, so the public constructor has no panic path here. Add tests/parser.rs::r13_block_image_schema_is_checked_without_a_layout_consumer using the exact action-only object above: Object::parse must return Err for 42 and the listed malformed variants. Add tests/cli_xam.rs::r13_cli_rejects_invalid_block_image with hash/check/run-action: expected exit 1, empty stdout, a cited diagnostic, before execution. Add absent-field and declared disk=512 zero bytes positive controls; both must still check and execute X|0>=|1>, and the action envelope/hash must remain unchanged because §9.2 excludes its layout. Add a library constructor regression for the missing-image R variant requiring a reported error rather than unwinding (after the parser fix, the ordinary parse path should reject first). These admission assertions fail on 932f19b. This is not among staged deliverables 8–11 and requires no new restriction on legal symbol/interface names.
